title: Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation: Rethinking Machine Translation Evaluation in the Era of Human-Level Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As machine translation systems approach human-level quality, traditional evaluation methodologies struggle to detect subtle translation errors. We critically examine limitations in current gold-standard approaches (MQM and ESA), including inconsistencies from variable annotator expertise, excessive categorization complexity, coarse severity granularity, accuracy bias over fluency, and time constraints. To address this issue, we introduce a high-quality dataset consisting of human evaluations for English-Russian translations from WMT24, created by professional linguists. We show that expert assessments without time pressure yield substantially different results from standard evaluations. To enable consistent and rich annotation by these experts, we developed the RATE (Refined Assessment for Translation Evaluation) protocol. translated_title: 精细化翻译评估：在人类水平系统时代重新思考机器翻译评估
translated_abstract: 随着机器翻译系统接近人类水平质量，传统评估方法难以检测细微的翻译错误。我们批判性地审视了当前黄金标准方法（MQM 和 ESA）的局限性，包括标注者专业水平参差不齐导致的不一致性、过于复杂的分类体系、粗糙的严重程度粒度、重准确性而轻流利度的偏差，以及时间限制。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个高质量数据集，该数据集由专业语言学家对 WMT24 英俄翻译的人工评估构成。我们表明，无时间压力下的专家评估所产生的结果与标准评估大不相同。为使这些专家能够进行一致且丰富的标注，我们开发了 RATE（精细化翻译评估）协议。RATE 提供了简化的错误分类体系、扩展的严重程度评级，以及平衡准确性与流利度的多维评分。
tldr: 该论文提出 RATE 评估协议及由专业语言学家构建的 WMT24 英俄翻译高质量人工评估数据集，以解决传统机器翻译评估方法（MQM/ESA）在人类水平翻译系统时代难以捕捉细微错误的问题。
